JCFC Hotline — phone tree — Twilio Studio build sheet
============================================================

Widgets: 40 of 1000
Longest route: ~20 steps (cap is 1000 per call)

Rooms are ordered shallowest first, so working down this sheet means
descending the dungeon.

A dungeon loops, so some transitions necessarily point at rooms further
down the sheet. Those are marked (later) — drop the widget in now and
wire that transition once you reach its target, or place every widget
first and wire the whole flow afterwards.

Nothing in this flow is spoken by Twilio. Anything without a recording is
simply not emitted, so a room, round or refusal with no take is silence on
the phone. The audio manifest lists every one of them.

BEFORE YOU START — things to check:

PATIENCE VALVE
Studio stops an execution if the same widget runs 10 times in a row, so a caller
mashing a locked door gets hung up on. Route the 8th consecutive refusal to an
escape node instead of back to the gather.

JCFC Hotline — phone tree
============================================================

## FOR_GORGEOUS_DOLPHIN_PRESS — For Gorgeous Dolphin, press 1. For Fast…

For Gorgeous Dolphin, press 1. For Fast Dolphin, press 2. For Chicken Soup for My Ass, press 3. For To Brenda, With Love, press 4. For Head Phonics Vol.1, press 5.

   Press 1 to Gorgeous Dolphin.
   Press 2 to Fast Dolphin
   Press 3 to Chicken Soup for My Ass
   Press 4 to To Brenda, With Love
   Press 5 to Head Phonics Vol.1


## GREAT_CHOICE_LET_ME — Great Choice. Let me walk you through the track…

Great Choice. Let me walk you through the track list. For Sing Me a Song, press 1. For Please Don't Arrest My Friend Richie, press 2. For Froggum Duder, Press 3. For Borgification Pt.1, press 4. For Gorilla Greetings, press 5. For Mike's Been Borgified And Now All His Songs Sound Like This And I Think It's Fine, press 6. For Sitting in the Middle of the Road on My Motorcycle Eating Chestnuts(Cause I'm a Sand Ghoul), press 7. For Check In, press 8. For Melancholy Beeping, press 9. For Ugly Friends, press 10. For Friday Night at the Satin Wizard, press 11. For Lil Godzilla, press 12. For Salazar Has My Boots, press 13. For JCFC PSA #1, press 14. For Baby Smokin Cigs, press 15. For Latenight Bobcat, press 16. For Robot Johnny, press 17. For Only a Little, press 18. For Dogs Eat Rocks, press 19. For Silk Jackie Chan Pajamas, press 20.
